test_cases.title: Following a list link opens the expected page
acs: DERIVED: List links open the pages recorded by the survey - 7 links (data/drill.json)
assumptions: Data table: the Examples table of the matching scenario outline lists every row; each row is one execution.
Read-only: nothing is created, saved or deleted, so no data cleanup is needed.
Representative sample: one row stands for the 7 similar rows; the full list is kept in docs/full-examples/ and can be restored.

steps.action: Open the list in the current row of http://localhost:1946.
Click the link named in the row.

steps.expected: The h1 matches the heading in the row.

steps.action: Check for a server error message.
steps.expected: No server error page is shown.

open_questions: DERIVED criteria come from a survey of the running apps and the page source; confirm the headings and messages are the intended behaviour.
